'''Shaofan''' is, or was, the [[Sh'botay]] of [[Shara]] until he, along with [[Sh'boan]] [[Chiape]], were kidnapped by [[Graendal]] as part of a ruse.

==Appearance==
Shaofan is a very handsome man who has very dark skin.

==Activities==
[[Graendal]] kidnapped both Shaofan and Chiape and placed them under very heavy [[Compulsion]]. Graendal did this only to display them to [[Sammael]].{{ref/book|6|6}}

==Impact==
The disappearance of Shaofan and Chiape from Shara, as well as the rebirth of the [[Dragon]], causes a power vacuum in their native land and war in the country.{{ref/book|6|17}} It is unknown if he was in [[Natrin's Barrow]] when [[Rand al'Thor]] used [[balefire]] against it.{{ref/book|12|37}}
